name: The Neuroscience School: Short Courses for High School Students
org: Georgia State University, Center for Behavioral Neuroscience
what_you_do: Take a one-week summer neuroscience course taught by Georgia State professors. Choices include a Boot Camp, fruit fly lab courses on Alzheimer's or stress, and advanced topics. Some run in person, some online.
deadline_text: In 2026, registration stayed open until classes were full, and classes without enough sign-ups by June 1 were canceled. The 2026 schedule was posted in December 2025. 2027 courses are not posted.

name: Black Girls Code Workshops
what_you_do: You can join workshops in robotics, art and AI for girls ages 7 to 18. Free Code Along videos on YouTube and mentoring chances are also available.
deadline_text: See the events page for current workshops.

name: Jacobs Composition Academy (online)
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A 12-week online program for people who write music, of many ages and skill levels. You get private lessons (Track 1) and a weekly group class. It ends with a live play and recording of your new piece by IU student musicians.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 semester: registration and payment close January 11, classes start January 18, concerts April 1 to 16. The page says Spring 2027 registration begins in mid November.

grades: Current sophomores, juniors and seniors (virtual); rising juniors and seniors (in-person)
name: Kelley Women's Leadership Institute
org: Indiana University Kelley School of Business
what_you_do: This is a one-day in-person business program. A two-day virtual option is also available. You hear lectures from Kelley faculty. You join a team case competition. You build leadership skills.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 in-person sessions June 25, July 9, July 16, July 30. Spring 2027 virtual sessions April 7 and 14. Application opens Jan 4, 2027 and closes Mar 19, 2027.

name: Summer Experience in Sustainability and the Environment (SESE)
org: Indiana University, Environment, Society, and Sustainability Institute (ESSI)
what_you_do: This is a free online pre-college program. IU faculty, researchers and grad students lead daily lessons on climate change, biodiversity and environmental justice. You get a certificate.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 cohort will open January 2027. Closing date and program dates not posted.

name: Beaver Works Summer Institute (BWSI)
what_you_do: Take a free online course first. Then join a four week summer program. The courses are hands-on and project based. Topics include artificial intelligence, autonomy, radar and satellites. In person options are available.
grades: Designed for students entering their senior year of high school
deadline_text: The page says "BWSI 2027 Online Prerequisites are Now Open!" Self registration for the online course is open now. Approvals come in late January, the online course opens February 1, the summer application is sent in March, nominations are accepted through March 31, and the teacher or mentor recommendation is due April 2. The page does not give a final date for the summer application.

name: Congressional App Challenge
what_you_do: Build an app in any language and submit it to your House district. Winners are shown at the US Capitol.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline for registering and submitting is October 26, 2026.

grades: High school (grade levels not stated on the page)
name: DECA high school chapters and competitions
what_you_do: Join a business club at your school. Members practice role-plays and take tests in sales, money, hotels and management. Then they compete at district, state and international events.
deadline_text: Join through your school chapter any time. 2026-27 national events: Ultimate DECA Power Trip Nov 20 to 22, 2026 (Louisville KY); Sports and Entertainment Marketing Conference Jan 27 to 31, 2027 (Orlando FL); International Career Development Conference Apr 17 to 20, 2027 (Anaheim CA).

name: Exploring (Learning for Life career posts)
what_you_do: You can join career exploration posts in 12 fields. Fields include health care, law enforcement, fire, engineering, and law and government. The posts include hands-on activities.
deadline_text: The program pages do not state application dates.

name: High School Fed Challenge
org: Federal Reserve Bank of New York (national), Chicago Fed (regional page)
what_you_do: A school team studies the economy and plays the part of the Fed's rate-setting committee. The 2026-27 theme is the economics of housing. Teams submit a paper, and top teams are chosen.
deadline_text: Team registration closes Feb 15, 2027 at 11:59 pm ET. Paper due Mar 15, 2027. Notice to teams May 14, 2027.

name: Forage Virtual Job Simulations
what_you_do: Free, self-paced online job simulations. They copy real work tasks. You can compare your answers to model answers. There are over 250 simulations from more than 90 employers.
deadline_text: Always open.

name: Girls Who Code Clubs and Pathways
what_you_do: You can join a free coding club for grades 3 to 12. It meets after school or on weekends. You can also take the free, self-paced online Pathways program for high school students.
grades: Clubs: grades 3 to 12 (split 3 to 5 and 6 to 12). Pathways: high school.
deadline_text: Ongoing.

name: Hack Club
what_you_do: You can join Hack Club. It is a free teen coding community. It has school clubs and an online Slack. It has game jams, hackathons and hardware events.
deadline_text: Join anytime.

name: Hacktoberfest 2026
what_you_do: In October you can join online challenges and livestreams, or go to one of over 500 local in-person fests. This year the event focuses on open source and open-weight AI.
deadline_text: Runs through October 2026; sign in with MyMLH.

name: HPU 600: College Classes for High School Students
what_you_do: High school students take college credit classes online. Classes are in arts and humanities, computer science, criminal justice and leadership, and math and science. Classes are taught on your own schedule, not live.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 terms: Term A Aug 31 to Oct 25, Term B Oct 26 to Dec 20, or a 16 week term Aug 31 to Dec 20. The registration deadline is not stated on the program page.

name: HOSA Future Health Professionals
what_you_do: You can join this student group for health science students. It has skills contests, leadership events and health career exploration.
grades: Secondary and college students (exact grades not stated)
deadline_text: Join through your health science teacher.

name: Key Club (high school service club)
what_you_do: You do service, leadership and fundraising through a student-led club at your school. If your school has no club, you can start one.
deadline_text: Join your school's club or start one. No cycle stated.

name: Khan Academy college and careers courses
what_you_do: You can take free online lessons on the Khan Academy Life skills page. Topics include financial literacy, personal finance, entrepreneurship, career exploration and college admissions.
deadline_text: Always open.

name: Kode With Klossy
city: Virtual and in-person (Oakland, San Francisco and more)
what_you_do: You can join a free coding program for girls and gender-expansive teens ages 13 to 18. Choices include a two-day Code-a-Bration or a two-week Camp in summer.
deadline_text: Sign-ups are open for Code-a-Bration (Nov 7 to 8, 2026 in Oakland and virtual; Oct 17 to 18 in Chicago and virtual). Summer 2027 Camp applications open in February 2027; closing dates not posted.

name: Accelerated Learning Program (Badger Precollege)
what_you_do: Three weeks on the UW-Madison campus focused on one college-level course (95 class hours).
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 12, scholarships due Apr 1, application deadline May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Badger Summer Scholars (Badger Precollege)
what_you_do: Take a college-level course of your choice for two weeks on the UW-Madison campus. Residential students live in a residence hall.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 12, scholarships due Apr 1, application deadline May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Current sophomore or junior (the page also says 'rising juniors and seniors', so confirm)
name: Engineering Summer Program (ESP)
what_you_do: This is a three-week program on campus. You study math, physics, chemistry and engineering design. You do hands-on workshops. You visit industry sites. Faculty mentor you.
deadline_text: 2026 application is closed and decisions were sent. No 2027 deadline posted.

name: Social Impact Leadership Online
what_you_do: An online course where students design and carry out a project that tackles a problem they care about, in teams or alone. They practice leadership, teamwork and public speaking.
deadline_text: Registration deadline January 8, 2027.

name: Major League Hacking (MLH) hackathons
what_you_do: Major League Hacking runs student hackathons. These are short coding contests. It also runs coding events. It has a 12-week remote Fellowship that pays a stipend. Most listed hackathons do not say high school students can enter.
deadline_text: Dates differ by event. See the 2027 season events list. California events listed: DiamondHacks (La Jolla, Apr 4 to 5, 2027) and LA Hacks (Los Angeles, Apr 16 to 18, 2027).

name: Summer Pre-College Program
what_you_do: Take online college courses taught by Morehouse faculty. Plan on about 50 minutes a day, Monday to Friday. You earn Morehouse College credit for each course you pass.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications Jan 5 to Mar 15, 2026, decisions Apr 5, payment due May 1. 2027 dates not posted.

name: NASA Citizen Science Projects
what_you_do: Join one of 49 NASA science projects online. Examples include classifying images or tracking clouds. You need only a phone or laptop.
deadline_text: Always open.

name: NASA GeneLab for High Schools (GL4HS)
city: Virtual (hosted by NASA Ames, Mountain View, CA)
what_you_do: This is a 12-week online program. You go at your own pace. It takes about 20 hours a week. Topics include space biology and bioinformatics. Bioinformatics means using computers to study biology data. Computational biology is also a topic.
grades: Rising juniors and seniors (and college freshmen)
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 15 to Mar 15, 2026, or until 1,000 applicants. 2027 dates not posted.

name: National Economics Challenge
what_you_do: Take a test on small and large economics and the world economy. Compete for cash prizes. There are two groups: Adam Smith (AP, honors and returning players) and David Ricardo (first-time players).
deadline_text: 2026-27 registration is not open yet. No dates are posted.

name: Job Corps (free career training for ages 16 to 24)
org: U.S. Department of Labor, Job Corps
what_you_do: Job Corps is free career training and a high school diploma or GED path, run on campuses across the country. Students can live on campus and get a living allowance.
deadline_text: Apply any time. The site says the decision usually takes about two months.

name: YouthBuild (find a local program)
what_you_do: Young people who left school and are not working train for job skills in construction and other fields, and work on a diploma or equivalent. Each local YouthBuild program runs on its own.
deadline_text: No dates on the national page. Each local program sets its own.

name: 36 Hours to Save the World (Global Challenge Weekend)
what_you_do: Online weekend contest for teams of high school students. You research a global problem, pitch ideas, build a prototype and present to judges.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 challenge is Oct 23-25, 2026. Register by Oct 12, 2026.

name: Online Research Academy
org: NC State Global Training Initiative with UNC Wilmington
what_you_do: A four-week online research program. You meet with a faculty mentor twice a week, learn how research works and do a project. You get a certificate and a letter of evaluation.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 29 to July 31, 2026. Applications opened March 1 and closed June 10, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: World Series of Innovation (Impact League)
what_you_do: Come up with an idea that solves a real problem and enter it in a free online innovation challenge. You can enter alone or with a team. Cash prizes go to winning teams.
deadline_text: Entries are due Dec 13, 2026. The 2026-2027 challenge launched Sept 9, 2026.

name: National Park Service Youth Conservation Corps (YCC)
city: Participating national parks (see the NPS park list)
what_you_do: You can get a paid summer conservation job at a national park, working outdoors on park projects. Each park runs its own program.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 season open in late January or early February 2027. Closing dates are set by each park and are not posted.

name: Business Bootcamp (free online workshops for high schoolers)
org: New York Institute of Technology (New York Tech), School of Management
what_you_do: Join a one-hour workshop on Zoom, like a college class. Business teachers lead it. Topics include money skills, buying stocks or real estate, a plan to market yourself, and job interviews.
deadline_text: Page lists sessions (years not printed, likely 2026): Oct 20 Financial Literacy; Nov 17 Investing and Strategic Planning; Dec 15 Standing Out in a Job Interview. Register for each session separately.

name: Make-A-Wish Youth Leadership Council (Greater Pittsburgh)
org: Make-A-Wish Greater Pennsylvania and West Virginia
what_you_do: Meet with Make-A-Wish staff and learn how nonprofits work. The groups support granting wishes for children with critical illnesses. In-person members attend monthly meetings.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Meeting days are set by the group at its first meeting.

name: American Red Cross Babysitting and Child Care Training
what_you_do: You take a Red Cross course on caring for infants and children, safety and emergencies. The online option also covers starting a babysitting business.
deadline_text: Ongoing.

name: Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF)
what_you_do: It is the world's largest pre-college science fair. You first win a spot at a local fair affiliated with the Society for Science, then compete at ISEF in 22 categories.
deadline_text: ISEF is in Los Angeles in May 2027 (exact dates not posted on the program pages). Affiliated fairs end by mid-April, and each fair sets its own deadline, so find yours now.

name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
what_you_do: High school seniors submit an independent research project. The top 300 get recognition. The top 40 compete in Washington for awards.
deadline_text: Applications close Nov 5, 2026 at 8 p.m. ET (opened June 1, 2026). Top 300 announced Jan 7, 2027; Top 40 announced Jan 21, 2027; finals week Mar 11 to 17, 2027.

name: Research Science Institute (RSI)
org: Center for Excellence in Education with MIT
what_you_do: You join a free summer program for 100 top students. It has one week of STEM classes taught by professors, then five weeks of individual research with a mentor. The program ends with a research paper and a presentation at the RSI Symposium.
deadline_text: RSI 2027 applications are open through 11:59 p.m. on December 11, 2026. No late applications.

name: UC San Diego Bioengineering Research Scholars
org: UC San Diego Department of Bioengineering and Division of Extended Studies
city: La Jolla, San Diego, CA (live online)
what_you_do: Take live online bioengineering courses with a loaner lab kit. Start with an intro course, then a research workshop, then plan and carry out your own project with a university lab.
deadline_text: Winter 2027 application deadline Dec 18, 2026, with a last call through Jan 3, 2027. Space is limited and may fill sooner.

name: SkillsUSA
what_you_do: You can join a career and technical education club at school. It offers skills contests. It offers leadership training. It connects you to employers.
deadline_text: Join through your CTE teacher. No cycle stated.

name: Stanford Pre-Collegiate Summer Institutes
what_you_do: You can take one live online college-style course, Monday to Friday for two weeks, as a middle or high school student. You may take only one course per summer.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was Mar 13, 2026 (decisions mid-May 2026). 2027 dates not posted.

name: The Stock Market Game
what_you_do: Play an online investing game with a pretend portfolio. You learn how stocks, bonds and risk work. You pick how long it runs, from several weeks to a full school year.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026-2027 is open. Specific session dates are not posted on the main page.

name: UC Scout Online High School Courses
what_you_do: You can take UC-approved online high school and AP courses at your own pace.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 enrollment is open now, according to the site.

name: SEES (STEM Enhancement in Earth Science) Summer High School Intern Program
org: UT Austin Center for Space Research with NASA and the Texas Space Grant Consortium
what_you_do: Work in a team with NASA and aerospace experts on real mission data (Earth science, astronomy, engineering). Includes online modules, mentor-led projects, and a final virtual symposium; some interns attend two weeks on site at UT.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline: February 22, 2026 at 8:00 p.m. PT, no late applications. 2027 dates are not posted; the page says future funding is not guaranteed.

name: My Introduction to Engineering (MITE)
org: Cockrell School of Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: This is a five-day residential summer camp for rising seniors. You live on campus. Your team does an engineering project and hands-on activities. You spend time with engineering students, faculty and alumni.
deadline_text: Applications for MITE 2026 closed March 1, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Virtual Enterprises International
what_you_do: You can take a class where you run a simulated business. The class has trade shows and competitions. It ends with a Youth Business Summit.
deadline_text: Depends on your school.

name: Wharton Global High School Investment Competition
org: Wharton Global Youth Program, University of Pennsylvania
what_you_do: Teams of four to six run a pretend portfolio on the Wharton Investment Simulator. They write a trading review, a plan for investing and a final report. The top 10 teams go to Wharton for the finale.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026-27 is closed (it ran Aug 10 to Sept 11, 2026). Trading began Sept 28, 2026. Finale Apr 29 to 30, 2027, at Wharton in Philadelphia, PA.

name: Wikipedia Editing
what_you_do: Anyone can edit Wikipedia, even without an account. Start with small fixes and use the tutorials.
deadline_text: Always open.

name: Yellowstone Youth Conservation Corps (YCC)
org: National Park Service, Yellowstone National Park
what_you_do: A month-long paid program where teens work 40 hours a week in Yellowstone National Park.
deadline_text: The 2026 application period is closed (applicants were told their status by April 7, 2026). 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Zooniverse Citizen Science
what_you_do: You help real researchers. You classify images, audio and text. There are hundreds of online projects.
deadline_text: Always open.
